proposal_title: Release Identity Alignment & Deterministic 4-Stage Hashing Pipeline
domain_specific_rationale: From a Red Team and Software Supply Chain Security perspective, CP-015 eliminates critical integrity vulnerabilities in release generation and verification. Circular references in self-hashing manifests risked verification bypass or non-deterministic package states that an attacker could exploit to slip unvetted contract changes into production. The 4-stage deterministic hashing protocol (file hash calculation -> sorted entry tree hash -> non-self-referential manifest embedding -> archive digest) guarantees cryptographic immutability and verifiable provenance for the v1.0.0 freeze artifact.
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-17 (Auditability & Traceability) and CAP-19 (Deterministic Package Verification).
residual_risk: Residual Risk: Platform-specific line ending conversions (CRLF vs LF) or filesystem metadata discrepancies during cross-platform cloning (Windows vs macOS/Linux) could cause false-positive verification mismatches. Required Mitigation: Enforce .gitattributes with '* text=auto eol=lf' across all candidate repositories, and ensure verify_package.py operates strictly on binary streams or normalized byte arrays.
